children: opened a New York City fashion pop-up store to showcase its private labels and new clothes offerings. At an event that coincided with New York Fashion Week, Walmart

management highlighted Free Assembly and Scoop as among its most productive women's businesses, noting that Free Assembly is now in about 3,900 stores and growing in the triple digits. Women's label Scenario and Avia Men's were also introduced.
Jefferies analyst Corey Tarlowe said the firm came away encouraged by the continued progress elevating the apparel, accessories, and beauty businesses. Walmart

management's strategy of expanding and upgrading assortments, improving the in-store experience, and broadening customer reach was seen as a positive. "With 145M weekly customers and substantial customer spend not captured at WMT in fashion categories, WMT continues to see a significant opportunity to capture additional wallet share through improved style, quality, and brand offerings," wrote Tarlowe.

BTIG analyst Robert Drbul also walked away from the event impressed. "Walmart remains excellent in socks, underwear, white tees, and denim. Now Walmart is making a deliberate, multi-year push to democratize fashion, having launched or relaunched 15 brands in 5 years. This is not a one-off initiative," highlighted Drbul.
